purpose: Phase A bounded user-visible regression contract; validator-only data

variantCap.policy: representative neighbors only; no Monte Carlo or exhaustive matrices

families.canonicalRule: Defenders preserve central integrity, mark the dangerous ST, and retain wide/fullback responsibility without unexplained ball-chasing abandonment.
families.browserObservable: deterministic responsibility telemetry is sufficient; no screenshot required
families.mutation: remove dangerous-player owner and central cover
families.promotionGate: bad/control plus bounded LEFT/RIGHT and HOME/AWAY variants pass

families.canonicalRule: Only the committed protagonist choiceId and exact targetId may execute; no automatic pass, dribble, shot, or target substitution.
families.browserObservable: choice cursor, committed choiceId/targetId, and executed action/target telemetry
families.mutation: inject auto-action or replace the committed targetId
families.promotionGate: bad/control plus bounded LEFT/RIGHT target variants pass

families.canonicalRule: A committed action executes from the live pre-choice state and one-tempo continuation/replay begins at that current boundary; future outcomes are never precomputed.
families.browserObservable: pre-choice frame, committed boundary, continuation frame, and futureOutcomePrecomputed telemetry
families.mutation: reuse stale continuation snapshot or set futureOutcomePrecomputed=true
families.promotionGate: bad/control plus two neighboring deterministic seeds pass

families.canonicalRule: Set-piece end/direction, setup ownership, approach/contact, and restart state remain causally continuous.
families.browserObservable: restart type, direction/end, kicker/owner, and approach/contact/restart telemetry
families.mutation: flip end/direction or collapse setup owner assignment
families.promotionGate: both set-piece bad/control pairs plus LEFT/RIGHT and HOME/AWAY variants pass

families.canonicalRule: Engine reaction/contact/save-or-deflection state corresponds to visible GK pose, travel, recovery, and finite transforms.
families.browserObservable: first reaction, contact result, visible pose/travel/recovery, finite transform
families.mutation: distort visible pose/transform or break reaction timing
families.promotionGate: bad/control plus HOME/AWAY and one neighboring shot seed pass
